title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount Triple Tier With Towel Bar Solid Brass | Spanish Gold | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage to your bathroom with a 16-Inch wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and an integrated towel bar in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. This traditional bathroom hardware piece uses solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for strength and everyday use.

Highlights:
- Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Tempered glass is 3/8-inch thick with beveled edges
- Concealed screw wall mount installation
- Multiple finish options available, including statement colors

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws #8 x 1 1/4)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
